description.en:
Basic Attack - Cartethyia

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Following Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 4, inflict 1 stack of Aero Erosion on targets hit and summon Sword of Divinity's Shadow.
Up to 1 Sword of Divinity's Shadow may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.

Heavy Attack - Cartethyia

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG and summoning Sword of Discord's Shadow. Can be performed in mid-air.
Up to 1 Sword of Discord's Shadow may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.
This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia

Release Normal Attack button while airborne to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Aero DMG, also considered Aero Erosion DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after the Plunging Attack to perform Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2.
Casting Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia recalls all Sword Shadows. Based on the types and number of Sword Shadows recalled, perform different forms of Plunging Attack and obtain the corresponding Heart of Virtue, Mandate of Divinity, and Power of Discord.

Dodge Counter - Cartethyia

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack - Cartethyia

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun, memberikan Aero DMG.
Setelah Basic Attack - Cartethyia Tahap 4, menimpakan 1 stack Aero Erosion pada target yang terkena dan memanggil Sword of Divinity's Shadow.
Hingga 1 Sword of Divinity's Shadow dapat ada bersamaan, bertahan selama 20 dtk.

Heavy Attack - Cartethyia

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG dan memanggil Sword of Discord's Shadow. Dapat dilakukan di udara.
Hingga 1 Sword of Discord's Shadow dapat ada bersamaan, bertahan selama 20 dtk.
DMG ini dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia

Lepas tombol Normal Attack saat di udara untuk melakukan Plunging Attack dengan mengonsumsi STA, memberikan Aero DMG, juga dianggap sebagai Aero Erosion DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Plunging Attack untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Cartethyia Tahap 2.
Melancarkan Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia menarik kembali semua Sword Shadow. Berdasarkan jenis dan jumlah Sword Shadow yang ditarik kembali, melakukan bentuk Plunging Attack yang berbeda dan memperoleh Heart of Virtue, Mandate of Divinity, dan Power of Discord yang sesuai.

Dodge Counter - Cartethyia

Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en:
Resonance Skill - Cartethyia

Attack the target, launch nearby enemies, and then plunge them to the ground, dealing Aero DMG and inflicting 2 stacks of Aero Erosion on the targets hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG. Can be performed in mid-air.
Following Cartethyia - Resonance Skill, summon Sword of Virtue's Shadow.
Up to 1 Sword of Virtue's Shadow may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.
description.id:
Resonance Skill - Cartethyia

Menyerang target, melontarkan musuh di sekitar, lalu menghantam mereka ke tanah, memberikan Aero DMG dan menimpakan 2 stack Aero Erosion pada target yang terkena. DMG ini dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG. Dapat dilakukan di udara.
Setelah Cartethyia - Resonance Skill, memanggil Sword of Virtue's Shadow.
Hingga 1 Sword of Virtue's Shadow dapat ada bersamaan, bertahan selama 20 dtk.

description.en:
Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers

By reducing HP to 50% of the Max HP, Cartethyia transforms into Fleurdelys, unlocking new moves and entering the Manifest state for 12s.
Can be performed in mid-air.
Entering Manifest clears all Conviction.
As Fleurdelys, Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2, and Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides instantly trigger 1 instance of Aero Erosion DMG and reduce the Aero Erosion stack on the target hit by 1.
- Ending the state will not clear Resonance Energy.
- No HP cost when HP is below 50%.

Fleurdelys's attacks restore Conviction on hit. When Conviction reaches 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to cast Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.

When Conviction is below 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to transform back into Cartethyia. When in Manifest, casting Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers as Cartethyia consumes no Resonance Energy.

When Fleurdelys has Heart of Virtue in Manifest:
- Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 will generate a force field to Stagnate the targets within the range.
- Fleurdelys's resistance to interruption increases.
Heart of Virtue is removed when Manifest ends.

When Fleurdelys has Mandate of Divinity in Manifest:
Aero Erosion DMG is Amplified by 50% and the damage interval is decreased by 50% for enemies within a certain distance from Fleurdelys.
Mandate of Divinity is removed when Manifest ends.

When Fleurdelys has Power of Discord in Manifest:
When casting Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2 and Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys or after Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides deals damage, raise the Aero Erosion stacks on all nearby targets to the highest count among the targets.
Power of Discord is removed when Manifest ends.

Fleurdelys will transform back to Cartethyia during quest dialogues, environmental interaction animations, or using Utilities.
Fleurdelys can walk on water. Doing so on deep waters continuously consumes STA. When in walking state, Fleurdelys can step out of a high place and walk in mid-air by continuously consuming STA.

Avatar - Cartethyia

As Fleurdelys, when Conviction is below 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to perform Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2 and temporarily transform back to Cartethyia, which pauses the timer on Manifest.
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting the skill in mid-air performs Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia.

Avatar - Fleurdelys

When in Manifest, casting Resonance Liberation as Cartethyia performs Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2 without consuming Resonance Energy and transforms her back to Fleurdelys, which resumes the timer on Manifest.
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting this skill in mid-air performs Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 1.

Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall

When Fleurdelys has 120 points of Conviction, Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers is replaced by Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall removes all Conviction, ends Manifest, restores 50% of Max HP, and then deals Aero DMG to all targets in an area along a straight line in front. Upon hitting the target, remove all stacks of Aero Erosion on the target. Each stack removed Amplifies the DMG taken by the targets by 20%, up to 5 stacks.
Can be cast in mid-air.
description.id:
Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers

Dengan mengurangi HP hingga 50% dari Max HP, Cartethyia bertransformasi menjadi Fleurdelys, membuka gerakan baru dan memasuki kondisi Manifest selama 12 dtk.
Dapat dilakukan di udara.
Memasuki Manifest menghapus seluruh Conviction.
Sebagai Fleurdelys, Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 2, dan Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides langsung memicu 1 instance Aero Erosion DMG dan mengurangi stack Aero Erosion pada target yang terkena sebanyak 1.
- Mengakhiri kondisi ini tidak menghapus Resonance Energy.
- Tidak ada biaya HP saat HP di bawah 50%.

Serangan Fleurdelys memulihkan Conviction saat mengenai target. Saat Conviction mencapai 120 poin, tekan Resonance Liberation untuk melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.

Saat Conviction di bawah 120 poin, tekan Resonance Liberation untuk bertransformasi kembali menjadi Cartethyia. Saat dalam Manifest, melancarkan Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers sebagai Cartethyia tidak mengonsumsi Resonance Energy.

Saat Fleurdelys memiliki Heart of Virtue dalam Manifest:
- Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 4 menciptakan medan gaya untuk membuat target dalam jangkauan Stagnate.
- Ketahanan Fleurdelys terhadap interupsi meningkat.
Heart of Virtue dihapus saat Manifest berakhir.

Saat Fleurdelys memiliki Mandate of Divinity dalam Manifest:
Aero Erosion DMG mendapat Amplify sebesar 50% dan interval damage berkurang 50% untuk musuh dalam jarak tertentu dari Fleurdelys.
Mandate of Divinity dihapus saat Manifest berakhir.

Saat Fleurdelys memiliki Power of Discord dalam Manifest:
Saat melancarkan Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 2, dan Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys, atau setelah Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides memberikan damage, naikkan stack Aero Erosion pada semua target di sekitar hingga jumlah tertinggi di antara target tersebut.
Power of Discord dihapus saat Manifest berakhir.

Fleurdelys akan bertransformasi kembali menjadi Cartethyia saat dialog quest, animasi interaksi lingkungan, atau menggunakan Utilities.
Fleurdelys dapat berjalan di atas air. Melakukannya di perairan dalam terus mengonsumsi STA. Saat dalam kondisi berjalan, Fleurdelys dapat melangkah keluar dari tempat tinggi dan berjalan di udara dengan terus mengonsumsi STA.

Avatar - Cartethyia

Sebagai Fleurdelys, saat Conviction di bawah 120 poin, tekan Resonance Liberation untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Cartethyia Tahap 2 dan sementara bertransformasi kembali menjadi Cartethyia, yang menjeda timer Manifest.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara. Melancarkan skill ini di udara melakukan Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia.

Avatar - Fleurdelys

Saat dalam Manifest, melancarkan Resonance Liberation sebagai Cartethyia melakukan Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 2 tanpa mengonsumsi Resonance Energy dan mengubahnya kembali menjadi Fleurdelys, yang melanjutkan timer Manifest.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara. Melancarkan skill ini di udara melakukan Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 1.

Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall

Saat Fleurdelys memiliki 120 poin Conviction, Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers digantikan oleh Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.
Melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall menghapus seluruh Conviction, mengakhiri Manifest, memulihkan 50% Max HP, lalu memberikan Aero DMG ke semua target di suatu area sepanjang garis lurus di depan. Saat mengenai target, hapus semua stack Aero Erosion pada target. Setiap stack yang dihapus memberikan Amplify pada DMG yang diterima target sebesar 20%, hingga 5 stack.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

description.en: The healing received by all Resonators other than Cartethyia/Fleurdelys in the team is increased by 20% and their resistance to interruption is enhanced. If Rover: Aero is in the team, Rover: Aero additionally restores 25 Windstrings upon casting Omega Storm.
description.id: Healing yang diterima semua Resonator selain Cartethyia/Fleurdelys di tim meningkat sebesar 20% dan ketahanan mereka terhadap interupsi meningkat. Jika Rover: Aero ada di tim, Rover: Aero memulihkan tambahan 25 Windstrings saat melancarkan Omega Storm.

description.en: Targets with 1 to 3 stacks of Aero Erosion take 30% more DMG from Cartethyia and Fleurdelys. Targets with more than 3 stacks of Aero Erosion additionally take 10% more DMG from Cartethyia and Fleurdelys for each stack of Aero Erosion they have, up to 3 stacks.
description.id: Target dengan 1 hingga 3 stack Aero Erosion menerima 30% lebih banyak DMG dari Cartethyia dan Fleurdelys. Target dengan lebih dari 3 stack Aero Erosion menerima tambahan 10% lebih banyak DMG dari Cartethyia dan Fleurdelys untuk setiap stack Aero Erosion yang dimiliki, hingga 3 stack.

description.en:
Cartethyia - Sword to Mark Tide's Trace

Deal Aero DMG and inflict 2 stacks of Aero Erosion on targets hit. Summon Sword of Discord's Shadow.
Up to 1 Sword of Discord's Shadow may exist at the same time, lasting 20s.
Press Normal Attack shortly after Cartethyia - Sword to Mark Tide's Trace to perform Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2.

Fleurdelys - Sword to Call for Freedom

Thrust forward to impale the target, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction.
Press Normal Attack shortly after Fleurdelys - Sword to Call for Freedom to cast Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2.
description.id:
Cartethyia - Sword to Mark Tide's Trace

Memberikan Aero DMG dan menimpakan 2 stack Aero Erosion pada target yang terkena. Memanggil Sword of Discord's Shadow.
Hingga 1 Sword of Discord's Shadow dapat ada bersamaan, bertahan 20 dtk.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Cartethyia - Sword to Mark Tide's Trace untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Cartethyia Tahap 2.

Fleurdelys - Sword to Call for Freedom

Menusuk ke depan untuk menembus target, memberikan Aero DMG dan memulihkan Conviction.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Fleurdelys - Sword to Call for Freedom untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 2.

description.en:
Cartethyia unlocks new moves when she transforms into Fleurdelys:

Basic Attack - Fleurdelys

Basic Attack - Cartethyia is replaced by Basic Attack - Fleurdelys.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.

Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys

Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys.
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in the air at the cost of STA, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.
While airborne, hold Normal Attack to cast Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3.
Follow up with Basic Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3.
While airborne, casting Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call and Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides resets the cycle of Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys.

Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys

Heavy Attack - Cartethyia is replaced by Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys.
Thrust forward to deliver a focused strike, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.

Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys

While casting Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys, press Normal Attack again to cast Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys: fall back and blast the area in a straight line in front, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Follow up with Basic Attack shortly after casting Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys to cast Upward Cut - Fleurdelys.

Upward Cut - Fleurdelys

While Fleurdelys is on the ground, Jump to cast this skill, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.

Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys

Dodge Counter - Cartethyia is replaced by Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys.
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.
Follow up with Basic Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 .

Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call

Resonance Skill - Cartethyia is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call.
Summon a force field near the target's location to continuously pull in nearby targets, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides

Following Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call, press Resonance Skill again to call down a giant Sword Shadow to crush an area around the target, creating a force field to pull in nearby targets, dealing Aero DMG to ground targets, and restoring Conviction on hit.
Follow up with Basic Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3.
The Resonance Skill enters cooldown if Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides is not cast within a certain period or when switching to another Resonator.
Can be cast in mid-air.
description.id:
Cartethyia membuka gerakan baru saat bertransformasi menjadi Fleurdelys:

Basic Attack - Fleurdelys

Basic Attack - Cartethyia digantikan oleh Basic Attack - Fleurdelys.
Melakukan hingga 5 serangan beruntun, memberikan Aero DMG dan memulihkan Conviction saat mengenai target.

Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys

Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia digantikan oleh Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys.
Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun di udara dengan mengonsumsi STA, memberikan Aero DMG dan memulihkan Conviction saat mengenai target.
Saat di udara, tahan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 3.
Lanjutkan dengan Basic Attack sesaat setelahnya untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 3.
Saat di udara, melancarkan Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call dan Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides mereset siklus Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys.

Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys

Heavy Attack - Cartethyia digantikan oleh Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys.
Menusuk ke depan untuk melancarkan serangan terfokus, memberikan Aero DMG dan memulihkan Conviction saat mengenai target. DMG ini dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys

Saat melancarkan Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys, tekan Normal Attack lagi untuk melancarkan Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys: mundur dan meledakkan area sepanjang garis lurus di depan, memberikan Aero DMG dan memulihkan Conviction saat mengenai target. DMG ini dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
Lanjutkan dengan Basic Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys untuk melancarkan Upward Cut - Fleurdelys.

Upward Cut - Fleurdelys

Saat Fleurdelys berada di tanah, Lompat untuk melancarkan skill ini, memberikan Aero DMG dan memulihkan Conviction saat mengenai target.

Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys

Dodge Counter - Cartethyia digantikan oleh Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG dan memulihkan Conviction saat mengenai target.
Lanjutkan dengan Basic Attack sesaat setelahnya untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 4 .

Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call

Resonance Skill - Cartethyia digantikan oleh Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call.
Memanggil medan gaya di dekat lokasi target untuk terus menarik target di sekitar, memberikan Aero DMG dan memulihkan Conviction saat mengenai target.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides

Setelah Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call, tekan Resonance Skill lagi untuk menjatuhkan Sword Shadow raksasa yang menghancurkan area di sekitar target, menciptakan medan gaya untuk menarik target di sekitar, memberikan Aero DMG ke target di tanah, dan memulihkan Conviction saat mengenai target.
Lanjutkan dengan Basic Attack sesaat setelahnya untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 3.
Resonance Skill memasuki cooldown jika Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides tidak dilancarkan dalam jangka waktu tertentu atau saat berganti ke Resonator lain.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

description.id: Aero DMG yang diberikan Resonator aktif di tim selain Cartethyia/Fleurdelys ke target dengan Negative Status mendapat Amplify sebesar 17,5% selama 20 dtk.

description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en:
Gain Zeal that lasts for 10s when Cartethyia's or Fleurdelys's attacks directly damage and defeat targets inflicted with Aero Erosion.
In the Zeal state, upon defeating enemies, the next move that directly damages targets raises the Aero Erosion stacks on the targets to the highest count among the targets defeated. This will not exceed the current max Aero Erosion stack limit. Zeal is removed afterward and enters a 1s cooldown.
When Fleurdelys's Conviction hits 30/60/90/120, Fleurdelys's Crit. DMG is increased by 25% for 15s, up to 4 stacks. The duration of this effect does not reset upon gaining new stacks. After casting Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall, the increased Crit. DMG is removed.
description.id:
Mendapatkan Zeal yang bertahan selama 10 dtk saat serangan Cartethyia atau Fleurdelys secara langsung memberikan damage dan mengalahkan target yang terkena Aero Erosion.
Dalam kondisi Zeal, setelah mengalahkan musuh, gerakan berikutnya yang secara langsung memberikan damage ke target menaikkan stack Aero Erosion pada target hingga jumlah tertinggi di antara target yang dikalahkan. Ini tidak akan melebihi batas maksimum stack Aero Erosion saat ini. Zeal dihapus setelahnya dan memasuki cooldown 1 dtk.
Saat Conviction Fleurdelys mencapai 30/60/90/120, Crit. DMG Fleurdelys meningkat sebesar 25% selama 15 dtk, hingga 4 stack. Durasi efek ini tidak direset saat mendapat stack baru. Setelah melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall, peningkatan Crit. DMG dihapus.

description.en:
Casting Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers increases the max stack limit of Aero Erosion on targets within a certain range by 3 stacks. The next attack that directly damages the target inflicts 3 stack of Aero Erosion on all targets within a certain range and immediately triggers the Aero Erosion DMG on the targets hit once without consuming the Aero Erosion stacks.
The DMG Multipliers of Cartethyia's Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, and Intro Skill are increased by 50% and the DMG Multiplier of her Mid-air Attack is increased by 200%.
After casting Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia, every 1 type of Sword Shadow recalled reduces the cooldown of Resonance Skill - Cartethyia by 1s.
description.id:
Melancarkan Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers meningkatkan batas maksimum stack Aero Erosion pada target dalam jangkauan tertentu sebanyak 3 stack. Serangan berikutnya yang secara langsung memberikan damage ke target menimpakan 3 stack Aero Erosion pada semua target dalam jangkauan tertentu dan langsung memicu Aero Erosion DMG pada target yang terkena satu kali tanpa mengonsumsi stack Aero Erosion.
Pengali DMG Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, dan Intro Skill Cartethyia meningkat sebesar 50% dan pengali DMG Mid-air Attack-nya meningkat sebesar 200%.
Setelah melancarkan Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia, setiap 1 jenis Sword Shadow yang ditarik kembali mengurangi cooldown Resonance Skill - Cartethyia sebesar 1 dtk.

description.en:
Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2, Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys, and Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides now inflict 2 stacks of Aero Erosion on the targets hit.
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall is increased by 100%.
description.id:
Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Tahap 2, Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys, dan Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides kini menimpakan 2 stack Aero Erosion pada target yang terkena.
Pengali DMG Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall meningkat sebesar 100%.

description.en: After Resonators in the team inflict Havoc Bane, Fusion Burst, Spectro Frazzle, Electro Flare, Glacio Chafe, orAero Erosion, all Resonators in the team gain 20% DMG Bonus for all Attributes for 20s.
description.id: Setelah Resonator di tim menimpakan Havoc Bane, Fusion Burst, Spectro Frazzle, Electro Flare, Glacio Chafe, atau Aero Erosion, semua Resonator di tim mendapat 20% DMG Bonus untuk semua Attribute selama 20 dtk.

description.en:
When Cartethyia or Fleurdelys takes a fatal blow, they will not be downed by this instance of damage, but instead gain a Shield equal to 20% of Cartethyia's Max HP for 10s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 min.
The HP cost for casting Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers is reduced to 25% of Max HP.
description.id:
Saat Cartethyia atau Fleurdelys menerima serangan fatal, mereka tidak akan tumbang oleh damage tersebut, melainkan mendapat Shield sebesar 20% Max HP Cartethyia selama 10 dtk. Efek ini dapat aktif sekali setiap 10 menit.
Biaya HP untuk melancarkan Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers berkurang menjadi 25% Max HP.

description.en:
After casting Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall, raise the Aero Erosion stacks on the target hit to max. Casting Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall no longer removes the Aero Erosion stacks on the target.
Within 30s after casting Intro Skill - Sword to Mark Tide's Trace, Intro Skill - Sword to Call for Freedom, Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers, and Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall, when any Resonator in the team inflicts Aero Erosion on the targets with max stacks of Aero Erosion, immediately trigger the Aero Erosion DMG once.
The targets take 40% more DMG from Fleurdelys.
description.id:
Setelah melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall, naikkan stack Aero Erosion pada target yang terkena hingga maksimum. Melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall tidak lagi menghapus stack Aero Erosion pada target.
Dalam 30 dtk setelah melancarkan Intro Skill - Sword to Mark Tide's Trace, Intro Skill - Sword to Call for Freedom, Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers, dan Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall, saat Resonator mana pun di tim menimpakan Aero Erosion pada target dengan stack Aero Erosion maksimum, langsung memicu Aero Erosion DMG satu kali.
Target menerima 40% lebih banyak DMG dari Fleurdelys.
